items.title: Basic concept (buniyadi idea) of scalars and vectors (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the unnumbered opening section (PDF 23, printed 20).

blocks.text: Scalars aur vectors physics ke basic concepts (buniyadi ideas) hain. Physics ke bohat se sawalon mein pehle yeh pehchanna parta hai ke koi quantity scalar hai ya vector, taa ke us par sahi mathematics (hisaab) aur sahi concept (soch) lagaya ja sake. Scalars aur vectors samajh kar hum dekhte hain ke physics rozmarra ki zindagi mein kaise kaam aati hai, jaise total distance (kul tay kiya hua faasla) nikalna, jo scalar hai, ya kisi force ki magnitude (size) aur direction (simt) maloom karna, jo vector hai. Yeh cheezen seekhne se critical thinking (gehri soch) aur problem-solving (sawal hal karne) ki skills barhti hain.

Yeh chapter zyada tar vector algebra aur us ke istemal ke bare mein hai: straight line (seedhi line) mein uniform acceleration (ek jaisi acceleration) wali motion, uniform gravitational field mein freely falling (khud ba khud neeche girte) objects ki motion, projectile motion, aur one aur two dimensions mein objects ka aapas mein interaction (takrana).

blocks.prompt: Physics ko ek ke bajaye do qism ki quantities kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Kuch quantities sirf ek number aur unit se poori bata di jati hain, jaise chala hua distance. Kuch ke liye direction bhi batani parti hai, jaise darwaze par lagi force; inhen add ya multiply karte waqt direction ka khayal rakhna parta hai. Is liye scalar aur vector ko alag rakhte hain, taa ke pata ho kaun si mathematics lagani hai.

items: Scalar aur vector ki mathematics alag hoti hai. Yeh chapter vector algebra, straight line mein uniform acceleration, free fall, projectile aur ek aur do dimensions mein collisions parhata hai.
